world_character_configurations.create:
CREATE TABLE world_character_configurations (
	world_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	profile JSON NOT NULL, 
	settings JSON NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (world_character_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(snapshot_id) REFERENCES character_import_snapshots (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_character_id) REFERENCES world_characters (id)
)

character_import_snapshots.create:
CREATE TABLE character_import_snapshots (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	contract_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_revision VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	provenance VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	captured_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (source_character_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_character_import_snapshot_version CHECK (contract_version = 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_character_id) REFERENCES characters (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_character_import_snapshot_kind CHECK (kind IN ('creation','restored_initial','legacy_transition'))
)

character_draft_import_origins.create:
CREATE TABLE character_draft_import_origins (
	draft_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (draft_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES agent_creation_drafts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(snapshot_id) REFERENCES character_import_snapshots (id)
)

character_import_origins.create:
CREATE TABLE character_import_origins (
	character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (character_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(character_id) REFERENCES characters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(snapshot_id) REFERENCES character_import_snapshots (id)
)
